title: 8-Bit Battle Loop
preparation: Unity6.5 imported original OGG as PCM/DecompressOnLoad. LoopMusicImporter extracted all AudioClip frames with GetData and wrote PCM16 WAV. No time trim, pitch/time stretch, crossfade, padding, or added samples. Preserve the full1599-frame60Hz musical cycle.
limitations: A zero sample discontinuity is waveform evidence, not a subjective listening review or a complete musical seam guarantee on every hardware device.
